summary.name: VirtualStagingExpert
summary.one_liner: An AI web service that virtually stages, edits, and turns real estate photos into short videos for property listings.
use_cases: Staging empty rooms for property listings
Removing clutter or furniture from listing photos
Creating day-to-dusk or sky-replacement exterior shots
Turning a property photo into a short video clip
Producing social media assets for estate agents
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI tool that takes a property photo and produces edited versions: virtual staging across 18 styles and 13 room types, removing furniture or clutter, removing sale signs, day-to-dusk and cloudy-to-clear exterior edits, wall, floor and ceiling restyling, and renovation visualisation. A Photo To Video tool turns one photo into a 5-second 1080p clip. Users upload a photo, pick a tool, and download the result in high resolution. The page lists per-credit pricing on monthly plans and says five photos can be tried free.
notable: Per-photo tools priced at £2 and photo-to-video at £4, with a comparison against traditional staging and Photoshop experts
Five free photos to try without commitment
Free regenerations and no watermark on paid plans
caveats: Paid service: plans start at £20 per month, and five free credits are offered only as a trial
Pricing and performance figures (73% faster sales, 16% higher offers) are marketing claims on the page and are not independently verified
Monthly credit allowances limit how many properties can be processed on each plan
